title: Succeed the legacy Schedule B accrued-interest adjustment fact type onto a presented-claim successor. Adoption is a direct supersession root: it retires tax.us.2025.scheduleb.adjustment.accrued-interest.amount for the adopting workspace and presents (never silently converts) any then-current legacy finding as a successor claim. This is the migration act a workspace takes up, together with package.core-calculations.v35's rule.form1040-line2b v6, to leave the coexistence rule.form1040-line2b v5 and move off the legacy Schedule B accrued-interest form-row path.
